title: Six-Stack Personality Classification Pipeline
summary: A production-ready machine learning pipeline that predicts personality types via ensemble learning, feature engineering, and Optuna-based hyperparameter optimization for a Kaggle competition. It uses SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE) via sdv.single_table to generate synthetic samples for data augmentation.
